title: AI/Backend Engineer
summary: AI/Backend Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience (note: my dates span a Master's program from Sep 2023 to Dec 2025, so total relevant experience is just over three years, not the full calendar range). I build production-grade GenAI systems, not just demos. Most recently architected full RAG pipelines (LangChain, Redis vector store, LlamaIndex) and multi-agent LLM systems processing 10,000+ job listings per day, plus a generative AI chatbot powered by AWS Bedrock. More than three years of backend experience across Java/Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI, and Node.js/NestJS, with a track record of designing scalable REST APIs, optimizing database performance, and building CI/CD pipelines for platforms serving 3M+ customers. Focused on distributed backend systems, LLM integration, and agentic AI pipelines.

experience.description: Full Stack Engineer at Saayam for All (non-profit), contributing to internal tools and user-facing features that support the organization's programs. Developing microservices for Volunteer, Volunteer Org, Request, Generative AI, and Data Analytics using Spring Boot 3, JDK 17, and Python, deploying them in Kafka and AWS EKS (Kubernetes) environments.

Built a high-performance RAG pipeline using Python, LangChain, and a Redis vector store, enhancing the job-matching algorithm and reducing candidate retrieval latency by 45%. Led backend migration from PHP to TypeScript/Node.js (NestJS) to support a generative AI platform handling 100,000+ job postings. Developed LLM agents with LangChain to automate job posting analysis and client onboarding, processing 10,000+ listings per day. Implemented a metadata-enhanced RAG pipeline with LlamaIndex powering an 'Explore Jobs' feature, cutting job search latency by 60%. Designed a generative AI chatbot using AWS Bedrock over a knowledge base of job descriptions.

Designed and delivered 100+ RESTful APIs using Python (FastAPI) and TypeScript (NestJS), integrating frontend clients with microservices backends. Optimized PostgreSQL query performance by 30% through schema redesign and SQLAlchemy ORM refactoring. Led a code-quality team of 5, resolving 50+ critical bugs with Pytest and Jest. Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins for a platform serving 3 million+ customers. Contributed React Native (TypeScript) features that improved engagement by 35%.

Authored 10+ SQL queries on subscriber and usage datasets to analyze CDR-based billing workflows, ensuring data consistency across relational tables. Created 5+ Linux shell scripts to automate log inspection and data extraction. Achieved a 10% infrastructure cost reduction by migrating 20+ client applications from mainframe systems to AWS (EC2, S3, CloudWatch). Integrated Hibernate ORM, improving query efficiency by 20%.

Analyzed Java-based enterprise applications and relational databases, writing SQL queries and Linux shell scripts to validate data workflows. Streamlined wireless networks for performance and reliability, leveraging TCP/IP, Optical Fiber communication, and database systems.
